Description
The Momcozy 5.5 Inch Full HD Smart Non-WiFi Baby Monitor is a video baby monitor designed for parents who want clear, private, and smarter baby viewing without relying on home WiFi. It includes a dedicated parent unit and a 1080P Full HD baby monitor camera, giving families a secure local connection for everyday nursery check-ins, naps, and overnight monitoring.
BM03 Black combines a 5.5 inch Full HD screen, 1080P camera clarity, and a secure FHSS local connection with smart viewing features that make monitoring easier. Auto face focus helps keep your baby’s face easier to see on screen, while 360° pan, 140° tilt, and up to 4x zoom let you adjust the view as your baby moves. Smart sound, motion, cry, cough, and safe-zone notifications help parents notice meaningful changes without constantly watching the screen. Night view, two-way audio, and ENC noise reduction support clearer check-ins day and night.
The monitor and camera are made with smooth, durable plastic housing, softly rounded edges, and a clean matte finish. The parent unit feels comfortable to hold, with tactile physical buttons for quick control and a large screen that is easy to read during late-night use.
BM03 Black is ideal for parents who want a smart non-WiFi baby monitor, families who prefer a private local connection, and caregivers who need reliable room-to-room monitoring without opening an app. It supports multi-camera viewing and split-screen use, making it suitable for one nursery, siblings, or different rooms in the home.
For care, wipe the monitor and camera with a soft, dry cloth. Keep the device away from water, avoid harsh cleaners, and place the camera on a stable surface with a clear view of the baby’s sleep area. Storage card is not included.

What smart notificationss does the BM03 Black provide?
When enabled, the BM03 Black can notify you of crying, coughing, movement, and activity outside a preset safe zone. notificationss appear directly on the parent unit.
Are the cry and cough notifications medical monitoring features?
No. These features are designed to provide helpful sound-based notifications and are not intended to diagnose, treat, or prevent any medical condition. Detection results may vary depending on distance, placement, and background noise.
What does Face Focus do?
Face Focus automatically brings a detected face closer on the screen, making it easier to check on your baby without manually zooming every time.
Does the BM03 Black support two-way talk?
Yes. You can speak to your baby through the parent unit. ENC noise reduction helps reduce surrounding noise during two-way talk for clearer communication.
Does the BM03 Black require Wi-Fi or an app?
No. The BM03 Black uses a direct FHSS connection between the camera and the parent unit. No Wi-Fi, app, cloud account, or subscription is required.
Can I view the camera on my phone when I’m away from home?
No. The BM03 Black is designed for private local viewing on the included parent unit and does not support phone or cloud viewing.
Can I connect additional cameras?
Yes. One parent unit supports up to four cameras and split-screen monitoring. Additional cameras are sold separately.
How far does the signal reach?
The connection can reach up to 1,640 ft in an open area. Walls, floors, appliances, and other wireless devices may reduce the actual range. Signal Optimization lets you switch to a clearer channel when reception is weak.
Does the camera need to stay plugged in?
Yes. The camera does not have a built-in battery and must remain connected to power. The parent unit has a rechargeable battery and can be carried around the home.
How long does the parent unit battery last?
Under test conditions, the parent unit provides up to 72 hours of standby time. Actual battery life may vary depending on screen brightness, volume, alert frequency, and usage mode. The 72-hour rating refers to standby time, not continuous screen-on use.
Can I turn off the screen while keeping audio monitoring on?
Yes. With Power Saving Mode turned off, you can switch off the display while audio monitoring continues. VOX mode can also wake the screen automatically when sound is detected. Please note that audio monitoring stops when Power Saving Mode is enabled.
Does the package include a storage card?
No. A storage card is sold separately. The BM03 Black supports compatible storage cards up to 512 GB. A storage card is required for motion-triggered video clips, photos, and local playback, but not for live monitoring.
What is included in the box?
The package includes one 5.5-inch parent unit, one camera, two power adapters, two 2 m cables, and one user manual. A storage card and camera stand are not included.
